title: IT Support Engineer
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The IT Operations team keeps Anthropic running. We want every employee to do their best work without friction. We're hiring an IT Support Engineer who pairs strong technical skills with a service mindset and good judgment. Anthropic is growing fast, and IT needs to keep pace. That means onboarding at scale, automating repetitive work (including with Claude), and improving the day-to-day employee experience. You'll handle support across our mostly macOS environment and help with the operational work that lets us scale. You'll work closely with IT Engineering and Security, with room to grow into more technical infrastructure work over time. This isn't a scripted support role. You'll have real ownership, use your judgment to improve our processes, and grow with the team as we scale.

Key responsibilities

  • Triage and resolve issues across hardware, software, networking, and accounts, mostly through our ticketing system, plus Slack and in-person
  • Diagnose and fix issues across macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, and our core SaaS platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Atlassian)
  • Troubleshoot device issues, including enrollment, configuration profiles, and policy enforcement
  • Support access management and employee lifecycle workflows (onboarding, offboarding, reorgs)
  • Handle escalations that need cross-team coordination
  • Join an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours
  • Provide hands-on support for user technology, AV systems, conference rooms, and printers
  • Communicate clearly with users at every technical level
  • Write and maintain internal documentation, including runbooks, how-to guides, and knowledge base articles
  • Spot patterns in support requests, surface recurring issues, and flag opportunities to automate
  • Help streamline onboarding and other high-volume operations as we scale
  • Contribute to automation efforts
  • Maintain and improve device management, identity, and access systems
  • Write scripts (Bash, Python) to automate repetitive tasks

Minimum qualifications

  • Hands-on IT support experience, ideally in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience supporting macOS endpoints, and comfortable supporting ChromeOS, iOS, and Android
  • Experience with Google Workspace administration
  • Experience with Slack administration, including workspace management, permissions, and troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting and administering other SaaS tools
  • Understanding of identity and access fundamentals: SSO, MFA, directory services
  • Familiarity with MDM fundamentals and endpoint management concepts
  • Basic scripting (Bash or Python) for automation
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with a methodical and persistent approach
  • Clear communicator who enjoys helping people solve problems
  • Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with zero-trust security concepts and endpoint security tooling
  • Networking basics: DNS, DHCP, VPNs
  • Experience with IT projects beyond day-to-day support, such as migrations, tool rollouts, or process redesigns
  • Experience using AI tools to improve personal or team productivity
  • Interest in developing deeper technical skills and taking on more complex systems administration over time

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
€125.000—€165.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: IT Support Engineer, Executive Support
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

We're standing up a dedicated executive support function within IT, and we're hiring the IT Support Engineer who will build it. IT Support is the front door for every employee technology need at Anthropic, and this role creates its most visible lane: white-glove support for our executives, their administrative business partners (ABPs), and our board.

You'll define what that service looks like: the support model for execs, board, and ABPs, the runbooks behind it, the intake and escalation paths, and the trusted relationships with ABPs and exec staff that make it work. You'll set the bar for discretion and polish as you go. You'll also be the person our leadership reaches when technology gets in the way. The requests that land in this lane range from routine to highly sensitive, and many arrive urgent: an executive locked out minutes before a meeting, an AV issue in a room full of leadership, a board member who needs setup handled quietly and correctly the first time. You own the request end to end and pull in specialist functions or IT Engineering pods as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Stand up the executive support intake channels and run it: monitor, respond, and follow through on every request from executives, ABPs, and board members
  • Define the white-glove service model for discretion-sensitive asks and deliver to it, holding confidentiality under pressure
  • Design the board-meeting AV support playbook with the AV pod, and provide AV support for executive rooms and board meetings, from setup and pre-checks through live triage
  • Create exec-support runbooks and SLAs that keep the service consistent as it grows
  • Build trusted relationships with ABPs and executive staff, and establish clear intake paths so leadership knows exactly where to go
  • Handle ABP escalations and exec-urgent issues calmly, and route into specialist lanes or IT Engineering pods when a request needs them
  • Establish the board member device, account, and access setup process with our Onboarding lane
  • Work the shared ticket queue with the SF Core team: walk-ups, desk-side help, hardware swaps, it-assist overflow, and AV T1 triage
  • Participate in the Core on-call rotation and contribute to the knowledge base and runbooks
  • Maintain a regular on-site presence in San Francisco

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 7+ years of experience in IT support and 3+ years in executive support
  • Experience standing up a service or program from scratch, such as an executive support desk, a VIP support function, or a white-glove service
  • Experience supporting executives, their assistants, or a board to a white-glove standard
  • A track record of handling sensitive requests with discretion, and the judgment to know what stays confidential without being told
  • Strong hands-on IT support fundamentals: macOS-primary fleets, identity and access, SaaS troubleshooting, hardware lifecycle
  • AV fluency for executive rooms and board meetings: you can set up, verify, and fix a room under time pressure
  • Composure when an urgent escalation lands, and the judgment to know when to pull in help
  • High polish and low ego: you take pride in service quality and still pick up whatever the team needs, including the ordinary queue work
  • A security-first mindset and excellent judgment about when user experience yields to security requirements
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can make progress before the process exists, and you enjoy shaping how things should work
  • The instinct to write things down: runbooks, KB articles, and status updates that keep people informed

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a C-suite or board of directors at a company with significant security or compliance requirements
  • AV depth beyond first response, such as broadcast, live events, or room design input
  • Experience building runbooks, self-service content, or support automation
  • Experience supporting AI/ML research environments or highly technical user bases

title: Senior Executive IT Support Engineer, Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

AirSupport helps Airbnb employees stay productive wherever and however they work. Within AirSupport, Executive Support provides a dedicated, high-touch technology experience for Airbnb’s senior leaders and their Executive Business Partners.

The team combines deep technical expertise, proactive support, and strong cross-functional partnership across office, remote, travel, event, and other approved environments. Executive Support owns the executive technology experience, working closely with engineering, security, infrastructure, AV, workplace, and other technology partners who own the underlying technologies.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Executive IT Support Engineer, you will be one of the most senior technical individual contributors within AirSupport and a trusted technology partner to Airbnb’s executive population.

You will combine hands-on technical expertise with strong judgment, proactive planning, and cross-functional leadership. You will own complex and sensitive executive technology issues through resolution, anticipate risks before they become disruptions, and lead improvements that make the executive experience more reliable and supportable.

Your impact will extend beyond the issues you personally resolve. You will identify patterns in what Executive Support is seeing, connect them to broader employee technology priorities, develop recommendations, and influence the teams responsible for the underlying technology. You will help shape Executive Support technical direction, represent the support perspective in major technology decisions, and identify opportunities where solutions can benefit the broader employee population.

You will also help raise IT Support Engineering craft through technical leadership, mentoring, standards, knowledge sharing, and reusable practices.

A Typical Day

  • Provide direct, high-touch technology support for Airbnb executives and Executive Business Partners, taking end-to-end ownership of complex, sensitive, or time-critical issues.
  • Troubleshoot across endpoints and mobile devices, identity and access, connectivity, collaboration tools, AV and conferencing, workplace technology, and other systems that affect the executive experience.
  • Maintain ownership of the executive experience when an issue spans multiple technologies or teams, engaging the appropriate technical owners and driving the issue through resolution.
  • Build trusted relationships with executives and Executive Business Partners by understanding their workflows, technology environments, and upcoming priorities while exercising excellent discretion and judgment.
  • Own or coordinate executive technology lifecycle needs, including onboarding, offboarding, device transitions, and other changes that require continuity and careful planning.
  • Proactively prepare for board and leadership meetings, travel, launches, demonstrations, special events, and other high-visibility moments by identifying dependencies and addressing technology risks before they create disruption.
  • Identify recurring issues and broader patterns, develop recommendations for what should change, and lead cross-functional improvements that drive more scalable solutions.
  • Help shape Executive Support technical direction and improvement priorities based on executive needs, support signals, technology risk, and broader employee technology strategy.
  • Represent Executive Support in major technology initiatives, influencing design, readiness, rollout, and supportability for executive workflows and the broader employee experience.
  • Communicate complex issues, impact, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to executives and senior technical and business leaders.
  • Develop technical standards, troubleshooting approaches, readiness practices, runbooks, and knowledge; mentor other engineers; and help raise IT Support Engineering craft across the team.
  • Contribute to broader AirSupport priorities when Executive Support coverage and readiness allow, applying technical leadership and insights from the executive environment to work that improves the overall employee technology experience.
  • Participate in shared after-hours coverage and provide onsite, travel, event, or approved executive residential support when required.

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise IT support, workplace technology, systems support, or a related technical field, including meaningful experience supporting executives, senior leaders, or other high-touch and business-critical environments.
  • Strong hands-on technical capability across multiple technology domains, with deep expertise in one or more areas relevant to Executive Support.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise endpoints and mobile devices, endpoint management, identity and access, collaboration platforms, networking fundamentals, and video conferencing or workplace AV.
  • Experience taking ambiguous technical or operational problems, defining an approach, and driving work through implementation with limited direction.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify patterns across support issues and translate them into broader technical, operational, or service improvements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional work and influencing decisions across teams you do not directly manage.
  • Ability to develop a clear technical point of view, evaluate tradeoffs, and make recommendations that connect immediate support needs to broader technology and organizational priorities.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and communicate complex technical issues clearly and credibly with executives and senior technical and business leaders.
  • Excellent judgment, discretion, and composure in confidential, high-pressure, or high-visibility situations.
  • Demonstrated experience improving the capability of other engineers through mentoring, technical standards, documentation, cross-training, or other reusable practices.
  • A proactive approach to support: you look for recurring friction and emerging risks and work to prevent the next issue rather than only resolving the current one.
  • Ability to participate in an after-hours support rotation and provide occasional onsite, travel, event, or residential support based on business need.

Additional experience that may be helpful

  • Deep expertise in enterprise AV, video conferencing, live-event technology, or executive meeting environments.
  • Experience supporting executive travel, board meetings, major company events, or other high-stakes technology needs.
  • Experience with automation, scripting, AI-enabled support, or other tools that improve support quality and reduce repetitive work.
  • Experience supporting residential or other non-traditional technology environments within an enterprise security and support model.

Your Location:

This position needs to be based in the San Francisco office 40 hours a week, or as required by the business needs for the role.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$132,000—$155,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

This role is based in Tokyo, Japan and there is a 4 day/week in office expectation.

What Makes This Role Unique

You'll be joining a high-impact IT team supporting some of the world's leading AI researchers and engineers. The pace is fast and you'll have real ownership over your work. This isn't a role where you follow rigid scripts — you'll be trusted to use your judgment, improve our processes, and grow with the team. Because we're scaling rapidly, you'll have meaningful opportunities to shape how IT operations work at Anthropic.

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: IT Support Dublin, EMEA Regional Lead
description:
About the Team

The IT Services and Support team is responsible for delivering seamless, efficient, and reliable workplace technology across the organization. We provide frontline IT support, run employee lifecycle operations, support conference rooms and events, manage vendors and assets, and continuously improve systems, documentation, and workflows to strengthen the employee experience as OpenAI grows.

About the Role

As the EMEA Regional IT Support Lead based in Dublin, you will be the senior onsite IT owner for the Dublin office while serving as the regional lead for IT support across EMEA. You will combine high-quality hands-on support with regional coordination, operational leadership, and process improvement. Your scope includes frontline support, onboarding and offboarding, AV and event readiness, vendor and equipment management, office build and workplace technology support, executive support, and the design of scalable support workflows across offices and time zones.

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, technically strong, and able to operate independently in a fast-moving environment. You should bring strong judgment, clear communication, and the ability to turn ambiguous operational needs into reliable systems that improve the employee experience.

This role is the onsite IT lead in our Dublin office, serves as the regional lead for EMEA IT support, requires 5 days in office per week, and offers relocation assistance to new employees.

This role is based in our Dublin office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own EMEA IT Support: Take end-to-end ownership of the regional support experience, from prioritizing needs and resolving escalations to addressing systemic gaps and driving improvements.

  • Lead EMEA Regional Support: Partner across offices and time zones to improve coordination, strengthen support coverage, and drive a more consistent employee experience across EMEA.

  • Own Employee Lifecycle Operations: Lead or support onboarding and offboarding workflows including device preparation, account readiness, access coordination, and day-one support.

  • Drive AV and Event Readiness: Support conference rooms, executive meetings, events, and other high-visibility gatherings, ensuring workplace technology and AV systems are reliable.

  • Manage Vendors and Equipment: Coordinate procurement, repairs, maintenance, inventory tracking, and device management practices to maintain secure, standardized, and scalable operations.

  • Partner on Office Build and Workplace Technology: Work closely with Workplace Services, Security, and other stakeholders to support office growth, changes, and workplace technology readiness.

  • Improve Support Systems and Processes: Identify friction, improve documentation, build repeatable workflows, and introduce lightweight automation and scalable operational improvements across support, inventory, onboarding, and related IT processes.

  • Provide Executive and White-Glove Support: Deliver thoughtful, high-touch support for executives and other critical stakeholders when needed.

  • Collaborate across OpenAI: Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, align stakeholders, and drive well-scoped initiatives without relying on formal authority.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have strong technical expertise in macOS and working knowledge of Windows, along with identity and device management tools such as Azure AD, Jamf, and Intune.

  • Have hands-on experience with enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and Atlassian products.

  • Have experience configuring and troubleshooting AV and collaboration systems such as Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Crestron in office and event settings.

  • Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Have experience leading or coordinating support work across multiple offices, stakeholder groups, or time zones.

  • Have a track record of improving support operations through documentation, workflow design, automation, or lightweight scripting.

  • Can manage vendors, inventory, procurement, and workplace technology operations with strong execution and attention to detail.

  • Are effective at cross-functional project management and can move initiatives forward through influence, organization, and follow-through.

  • Bring a customer-first mindset, sound operational judgment, and the ability to stay calm and effective in high-pressure support situations.

  • Enjoy mentoring more junior teammates, supporting executives, and helping scale regional support practices.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
